# Quid

> Quid is a free iOS app for international students moving to the UK. It turns a monthly budget into a daily allowance in pounds and the student's home currency, provides a first-week settling-in checklist (bank account, SIM, GP registration, National Insurance number, Oyster), student deals, a community filtered by university and home country, and Quid AI, an in-app assistant for questions about UK student life. Quid never connects to a bank account; spends are logged by the user.

Facts: Free. iPhone only (iOS 15.1 or later), Android planned. Category: Finance. Developer: Arjun Bubbar; co-founders Arjun Bubbar and Nurlyza Lubis. Founded in London. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/quid-uk-student-life/id6791167493

## Pages

- [Home](https://quidapp.co.uk/): features, how set-up works, and 17 FAQs including verified answers on UK bank accounts, council tax exemption, GP registration, 18+ Student Oyster, 16-25 Railcard, National Insurance numbers, Student visa work hours, TV licences and eVisas.
- [Guides](https://quidapp.co.uk/guides/): sourced guides, checked 5 November 2026:
  - [Opening a UK bank account as an international student](https://quidapp.co.uk/guides/uk-bank-account-international-student)
  - [Council tax exemption for students](https://quidapp.co.uk/guides/council-tax-exemption-students)
  - [18+ Student Oyster vs 16-25 Railcard](https://quidapp.co.uk/guides/18-plus-oyster-vs-railcard)
- [About](https://quidapp.co.uk/about): the founders and why Quid exists.
- [Deals](https://quidapp.co.uk/deals): student deal categories (SIMs and eSIMs, tech and security, banking, travel, food and entertainment, health and housing).
- [Privacy Policy](https://quidapp.co.uk/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://quidapp.co.uk/terms)
